semantics.timing: Constant combinational output; no clock or cycle-dependent behavior.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization required; output continuously driven LOW.

verification.basis: Original problem only: output zero must always be LOW.
verification.static_review: Check exact module/port names, one-bit output, no inputs, and unconditional sized constant assignment.
verification.simulation: Independent dev_tb instantiates TopModule and checks zero with four-state case inequality after time-zero settling and at repeated later times.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite external timeouts.
verification.pass_criteria: Compilation exits zero, simulation exits zero and prints PASS; any X/Z/1 is a failure.
